nodes.text:
🦠 HMPV Scare: What parents need to know 🦠

With recent reports of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) in India, ripples of concern are spreading. But let’s set the record straight; there’s no need to panic.

✅ HMPV is not a new virus. It is a single-stranded, negative-sense RNA virus https://t.co/EZwur1Nc3y

nodes.author: sethrajeev_Dr
nodes.text:
and has been part of winter flu seasons for years but was rarely tested for. Now, as testing increases, so do the reported cases.

⚠️ Like any other flu virus, HMPV can occasionally lead to complications like pneumonia or bronchitis, but these are RARE

nodes.author: sethrajeev_Dr
nodes.text:
💡 What should you do?
✔️ Treat it like a regular viral infection: ensure rest, hydration, and hygiene.
✔️ Monitor symptoms and consult your doctor if they worsen.
✔️ Stay informed; don’t let misinformation spread fear.

Your calm and careful response is the best medicine for

nodes.author: sethrajeev_Dr
nodes.text:
your family. Let’s stay safe and sail through together! 💙
